name: Story County, IA
findings: Story County has 410 nonprofit organizations. 145 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 126 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Story County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few union organizations list public events
observations.text: No union organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 health care organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 34 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Story County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
